item.title: Spring Hokubu region treasure hunt location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: The spring Hokubu region treasure hunt is one of the weekly activities in Forza Horizon 6 Series 6, "Horizon Meets." Whenever a new hunt begins, a box appears somewhere on the map and, to locate it, the only hints you have are the region's name and a picture. Completing this challenge helps you get closer to claiming the weekly and the Series cars.

item.title: Epic Makes Survival Horror PC Game Completely Free for a Limited Time
item.description: The Epic Games Store is offering a great free PC game this week for users. For a limited time, you can grab a retro survival horror game at no charge.

item.title: Pokémon's TCG World Is Already Blowing Up Over 30th Anniversary's Eeveelution Release
item.description: Whether you're a Pokémon Trading Card Game scalper or collector, all eyes are on the release of the 30th Anniversary Ultra Premium Collection . Fans are salivating at the set's Espeon and Umbreon special illustration cards, and tempted by its exclusive Future Rare Pikachu cards. The product isn't on shelves yet, but resale prices are already through the roof. Early shipments of the UPC have started to trickle into the wild, and it's clear that the release will send shock waves through the TCG world.

item.title: Where to find Kinkaku-ji Temple in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: Kinkaku-ji Temple is an iconic location in Forza Horizon 6. Here's where to find the golden temple and how to get there.

item.title: New GTA 6 Song Is the Perfect Music To Commit Crimes To
item.description: Music has been integral to the Grand Theft Auto series, and electronic duo Justice is composing the soundtrack for Grand Theft Auto 6 . Justice released the laid-back and catchy tune " Flower in a Hurricane " a couple of weeks ago, and followed it up by dropping a new song on Thursday.

item.title: Helldivers 2 Players in Open Revolt Over Game’s Controversial Update
item.description: Things are not going well on Super Earth. Helldivers 2 fans are in open revolt after an Oct. 20 update added the already controversial Easy Anti-Cheat software. The game’s Steam rating has taken a massive hit, with a brutal Mostly Negative score (37% positive reviews) over its last 10,000 or so user scores.

item.title: Switch 2 Exclusive The Duskbloods Officially Delayed, Now Set for 2027
item.description: FromSoftware's The Duskbloods won't make its previously announced 2026 release window. The Elden Ring and Bloodborne developer announced Thursday that its Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive will now be released sometime in 2027. FromSoftware said in a statement that it's working to adjust the game's "rules and balance" following a player test this summer.

item.title: Phantom Blade Zero Explodes on Steam Charts on Day One
item.description: If players were already hyped for the release of Phantom Blade Zero , their anticipation only grew when the critic reviews were able to secure an average score of 88 on Metacritic , making it the highest-rated action game of the year . It might have been the final push they needed to buy it. On Oct. 29, Phantom Blade Zero became available on digital platforms, and thousands rushed to play it, as is evident from its impressive position on the Steam charts.

item.title: One of Steam’s Best Games of 2026 Is Now a Perfect Mobile Game
item.description: For a few months at the start of 2026, Titanium Court was the year’s worst kept secret. Jury members of the Independent Games Festival couldn’t stop hinting that Consume Me co-developer developer AP Thomson had a very special new game in the works. The lid came off once Titanium Court won the IGF’s coveted Seumas McNally Grand Prize in March and was met with critical buzz when it launched on Windows PC one month later.
